verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a named Collective Mode and says it shows combined availability for you and any number of teammates so recipients can book a time with the selected group. It also supports including external colleagues' calendars in that availability, which together covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that slots appear only when every required host is free (the intersection is implied by "combined availability" rather than stated), controls for marking specific hosts required vs. optional, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
